name: What kind of foundation work is needed for a garage conversion?

mainEntity.name: What kind of foundation work is needed for a garage conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Foundation work for a garage conversion typically involves assessing the existing slab for cracks or settling, reinforcing it if necessary, and potentially adding new footings if walls are being moved or a second story is planned. Ensuring the foundation can support the new load and meet seismic requirements for the Bay Area is crucial.
acceptedAnswer.description: Foundation work includes assessing and reinforcing the existing slab, and possibly adding footings to support new structures or loads.
